# V85 complication source audit

Fresh audit of all 100 core complication entries at pinned Compendium
`fb83a789da8f0327a389c277a0c790b1648d5810`. Read each complete body, including
introductory prose, benefits, drawbacks, special restrictions and referenced Dragon Knight traits.
This audit uses current main and pinned sources; no abandoned pilot material.

The existing wizard already represents the fixed skill/stat grants and supporting choices.
Confirmed changes are 35 missing prose actions/activities or alternate-use cards, two missing Dragon Dreams trait actions,
and the two explicit complication eligibility exclusions. The catalog now has 49 action records
across 39 complications. These totals describe the audited scope, not a test-count target.

Named embedded abilities retain their original bodies. Unnamed operations receive descriptive app
labels and the entire sourced complication body, including drawbacks. Printed durations and
unspecified timing remain literal; no invented combat action costs. Automatic consequences and
modifiers of existing movement, strikes, tests or payments do not become invented standalone actions.

## Completion boundaries

These are character-build and available-action grants, not complete gameplay automation. Parent
replacement revokes granted actions; Dragon Dreams depends on actual selected traits and current
Victories. Shared projection, persisted API proof and final review belong to the lead integration.

Remaining explicit gameplay dependencies include temporary class learning/use for Advanced Studies
and Getting Too Old for This; Loner/Shared Spirit runtime skill configuration; hero/antihero/destiny
tokens; follower/companion entities; source-specific cooldowns, transformations, identity states,
conditional penalties and narrative adjudication. Their operation cards disclose manual resolution.
Bereaved cannot pay an unimplemented hero-token pool. Grounded's duplicate-source range needs distinct runtime coverage; readable source is not that proof.
Starting rewards and item activation/reveal/repair are audited in V86, not silently activated here.
